name: Makido Shutters
description: Makido Shutters is a WordPress theme for industrial door and shutter contractors, roller shutter fitters and shopfront security specialists. A diagonal-split hero with a docked booking pill, a deep lens band that slides over the pinned hero, hairline notice boxes and a peeking door row present site measures, lead times and fixed prices in plain, exact language, in Schibsted Grotesk and Albert Sans.
